author: opencode-worker-4
text: RE-OPEN EVIDENCE (worker-4, rebuts the 'not reproducible' close): main itself fails to compile at cb4da0789c — verified on the canonical lichen-workspace checkout with a clean CARGO_TARGET_DIR: 'error: this file contains an unclosed delimiter, lichen-oscore/src/lib.rs:358' plus E0252 on SenderStateStore. The close-reason claims worker-1 has one re-export and green builds; but the canonical main tree has BOTH the line-19 re-export AND the grouped-import copy (grep count 2), AND the KeyUpdateRegistration impl block is mangled: duplicate one-line + multi-line 'fn load_sender' signatures, and the second 'load_recipient' body overwrote save_recipient's closing brace (brace count 42/40). Root cause is now pinned to the cb4da0789c merge itself — 'git show cb4da0789c -- rust/lichen-oscore/src/lib.rs' shows the conflict resolution concatenated BOTH sides' bodies instead of choosing one: worker-4's shape (RecipientReplayState/ContextStateStore re-exports, one-line load_sender, real load_recipient+save_recipient delegates) AND worker-5's shape (multi-line load_sender, load_recipient returning Ok(None)) both survived, interleaved. This is why it is not reproducible on beads-worker-1 (that branch has the clean pre-merge shape). Fix remains mechanical on main: keep worker-4's side of each conflict (real load_recipient+save_recipient with closing brace; one re-export). All rust work repo-wide remains blocked. cc Mark — the oscore human-only boundary needs a human hand on this file, or explicit delegation.
